game.name: The Warehouse
game.blurb: A 1990s THPS-style warehouse hall: a 5 m drop-in, a halfpipe, a quarter along the whole east wall under five windows, catwalks and rafters, and a boarded-up wall.

build.note: The Warehouse predates the level kit's data format: its layout is code in blender/park.py (built through levelkit/geo.py, materials.py and lighting.py).
